vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --format vcf --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --fasta reference.fa --variant_class --uploaded_allele --mask_header_cache_path [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: GRCh38 chromosome 21, the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's reference.fa.gz (its records' spans with N elsewhere) decompressed, passed to both engines on every run; in the database-mode runs it stands in for the database's sequence, as the Slice::seq redirection under --fasta reads the reference allele from it
input: variants.spdi.txt: 19 hand-built SPDI notations at the sites of the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's records on chromosome 21 of the GRCh38-release116 cache, in position order: substitutions written by letters on the NC_000021.9 accession, on chr21, on CM000683.2 and in lower case, and by length on 21; a two-base substitution by letters and one by length that shares its last base; a delins; deletions by letters with an empty and a 0 insertion and by length; two deletions written with their anchor base as a VCF writes them; insertions with an empty and a 0 deletion, one a 55-base run; and a notation with spaces around its colons; variants.vcf: the same 19 changes as VCF records in the same order, named by their design

spdi.vep_command: vep -i variants.spdi.txt -o <out> --database --host ensembldb.ensembl.org --port 3306 --db_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --fasta reference.fa --variant_class --uploaded_allele --mask_header_cache_path --format spdi [--tab|--vcf|--json]

spdi-guess.reference: the spdi set's expected_spdi, compared under format detection in place of --format spdi

generator: cache copied from tests/golden/116/GRCh38-identifiers (its json_cache and chr_synonyms.txt whole, the reference named from that corpus); variants.vcf and manifest.json by scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite GRCh38-input-spdi=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers spdi-input-format --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--variant_class --flag=--uploaded_allele --flag=--mask_header_cache_path --fasta-name ../GRCh38-identifiers/reference.fa.gz; expected/ by one container run per format of the base invocation on the full Ensembl cache; build_golden_corpus.py flag-set (two sets) and classify (the base run and the spdi set); expected_spdi/ by one container run per format of the same image in database mode against Ensembl's public MySQL at release 116, the four outputs gzipped and their sha256 recorded under flag_sets
